name: brainrouter-desktop
description: BrainRouter Desktop — native macOS/Windows shell (Electron + React) over the shared @kinqs/brainrouter-core agent runtime (the same engine the CLI uses).

scripts.build:deps: npm --prefix ../packages/types run build && npm --prefix ../packages/core run build
scripts.test: npm run build:deps && npm run typecheck && npm run build:electron && node --test "dist-electron/**/*.test.js" && tsx --test "src/**/*.test.ts" "scripts/**/*.test.ts"
scripts.start: npm run build:deps && npm run build && electron .
